preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode object representing the root of the binary tree.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
preconditions.description: Every node in the tree must be a valid TreeNode object with left and right attributes that are either None or TreeNode objects.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if root is None else return_value >= 1
postconditions.description: The function returns 0 if the tree is empty (root is None), otherwise it returns a positive integer representing the minimum number of vaccine kits required.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
postconditions.description: The vaccine kit supply logic is independent of node values; they are only used to identify nodes in the tree.
The returned value is the minimum number of vaccine kits required such that every house (node) is either supplied directly or covered by a parent or immediate child node with a kit.
